name: Arvin Duh
summary: Arvin Duh is a USC student graduating in Spring 2027 with a B.S. in AI for Business. During his 2026 internship at Google, he built an agent-eval framework that cut evaluation time from 6 hours to 20 minutes, a 30-agent swarm mapping 3,000+ CFO Org profiles, a document parser, a rebuilt LoC tool, and a CL auto-review dashboard.
